tools.name: scan_handoffs
tools.description: Pass the tasks your agents handed each other (e.g. the result of Offhand list_todos) and get back which are stalled or failing and what to do. A task is stalled when it is claimed (in_progress) or handed over but untouched for stall_minutes, and failing when it is blocked or has failed fail_limit ti

tools.name: nudge_log
tools.description: List the latest nudges and reassigns (Pro) or would-nudges (free) for one board or all boards on your key.

tools.name: weekly_report
tools.description: Draft a plain-English report of the last 7 days: stalled tasks found, nudges and reassigns made (Pro) or that would have been made (free). Read-only; sends nothing.

tools.name: usage_and_upgrade
tools.description: Show today's usage for your key or IP and the $9/month upgrade link. Free tier: 500 calls/day. Not metered.

findings.title: Anomalously long tool description
findings.detail: Description of "scan_handoffs" is 759 chars, far longer than this server's median (136). Overlong descriptions are a common place to bury instructions.

evidence.snippet: Pass the tasks your agents handed each other (e.g. the result of Offhand list_todos) and get back which are stalled or failing and what to do. A task is stalled…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: scan_handoffs · Private data: scan_handoffs · Public sink: scan_handoffs.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: scan_handoffs · Private data: scan_handoffs · Public sink: scan_handoffs

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
